integrity: The formula is derived by exact sign-configuration classification. Finite exact-rational enumeration supports rather than replaces the all-sample-count proof. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact conceptual pseudoinverse-based XNysTrace with iid independent Rademacher vectors on coordinate-diagonal rank-two PSD matrices only. No assertion about finite-precision implementations, Gaussian probes or rotated sign geometry. The mean-square error itself vanishes exponentially with sample count. Equivalent prior calculations may exist.
title: Exact false-zero posterior diagnostics for sign-probe XNysTrace on rank-two matrices
